secrets.name: PROXY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Bearer key clients must send as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on every /v1 request. Set your own value (any random string, e.g. output of: openssl rand -hex 32) in the Base44 Secrets page.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. If set, the proxy forwards chat completions to an OpenAI-compatible provider (override its URL with OPENAI_BASE_URL). Without it, a clearly-labeled deterministic mock provider responds so the API shape works with zero credentials.
